svg.title: Answer or abstain, and try to break GEL
svg.desc: Private build, earlier run on question set v1 (80 questions, an earlier build), beside three language models answering closed book. GEL RAM: 11 correct, 0 wrong, 69 UNKNOWN. GPT-OSS-120B: 10 correct, 21 wrong, 49 UNKNOWN. GPT-OSS-20B: 8 correct, 28 wrong, 44 UNKNOWN. Qwen3.8-27B: 6 correct, 11 wrong, 63 UNKNOWN. The public tool refuses a changed byte and a stale citation, reopens a snapshot with the same citation after a restart and checks a restored backup.
svg.text: PRIVATE BUILD · QUESTION SET V1 · 80 QUESTIONS, SAME RULE
UNKNOWN · 1–40 Polish, 41–80 English · models via the Groq API, closed book
TRY TO BREAK GEL · PUBLIC TOOL
Change one byte of a saved copy
the pin you kept no longer matches
Change the source after citing it
the old citation is out of date
a new process, the same pin
Back up, restore to a new path
Each is recorded; the recordings are linked below.
